summary: All Israel anoints David king—He takes Jerusalem and is blessed of the Lord—He conquers the Philistines.
meta_description: All Israel anoints David king—He takes Jerusalem and is blessed of the Lord—He conquers the Philistines.

footnotes.note9_b: The Hebrew root word suggests a fill, terrace, or elevation as part of the defense bastion. 1 Kgs. 9:15 (15, 24); 11:27; 2 Kgs. 12:20; 2 Chr. 32:5.
